narrative: Material PL1__MAE8631A shows moderate demand variability (CV=0.31) with no detectable trend over the 88-observation window spanning March 2025 to March 2026. Lead times are unstable (CV=0.414), ranging from 0.52 to 4.91 days, which drives a safety stock of 2,002 units at the 95% service level. The (r,Q) policy with order quantity capped at 6,640 units by the storage constraint reduces annual costs by 81.6% versus the current SAP MOQ-based approach.
warnings: Storage capacity constraint is active - order quantity limited by max storage (unconstrained EOQ=14,126 capped to 6,640)
Lead time variability is high (CV=0.414) - consider supplier performance review to reduce sigma_LT

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous and moderately variable with 100% non-zero days, making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy appropriate. EOQ provides the cost-optimal order quantity; the reorder point absorbs lead-time uncertainty via the safety stock term.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity binds hard: EOQ of 14,126 is reduced to 6,640, increasing orders/year from the economic optimum of ~18 to ~38 and raising ordering costs by ~$1,440/year. If capacity can be expanded to 16,128+ units, full EOQ savings are recoverable.
